title: Zuri RockStar (English)
description:
🎤 Welcome to the official Zuri channel! 🦦✨ Kids music with heart.

Zuri is a singing meerkat who turns every emotion into a song. Original POP, ROCK and R&B music videos with lyrics to sing along (sing-along / karaoke). For kids and preteens aged 8–14.

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell — new premieres every week.
🌍 Zuri also sings in Spanish (Zuri Rockstar) and Chinese (祖瑞摇滚秀).
